regions.today: Mostly cloudy this morning with mist, fog and drizzle in southern areas. Scattered showers will develop this afternoon and evening, with occasional sunny spells, though cloud will increase again towards evening. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees, in light to moderate southerly or variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Rain and drizzle will move in to the western part of the province early in the night, and move eastwards as the night goes on, though it will become lighter as it does. The rain will give way to mostly dry conditions, with good clear spells, and only isolated showers. Minimum temperatures will fall to between 7 and 12 degrees in the northwest of the province, but remain higher in the southeast where cloud and patchy rain will linger until morning, with lows of 13 to 15 degrees. There will be patches of mist and fog also, in light variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Mist and fog will clear tomorrow morning, along with any lingering rain in the southeast, leaving a mostly dry day with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, in light to moderate northwesterly or variable breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Low to Moderate on Tuesday and Wednesday.
